Minnesota: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Minnesota on the map

Key dates

  • Early voting (in-person absentee): September 18, 2026 to November 2, 2026. Vote early at your local elections office. Some locations may have shorter hours, so check with your county.
  • Deadline to register in advance (online or on paper): October 13, 2026. You can also register at your polling place on Election Day if you bring proof of residence.
  • Last day to request an absentee (mail) ballot: November 2, 2026. Request it at least two weeks early so you have time to get it back. Your ballot must arrive by Election Day.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Most polling places are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. Some small towns open later, as late as 10 a.m.

Official election information: vote.gov

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Federal

U.S. Senator

This seat has a six-year term. It is open because Senator Tina Smith (DFL) is not running again.

Governor & Lieutenant Governor

Governor and lieutenant governor are elected together on one ticket for a four-year term. The seat is open because Governor Tim Walz (DFL) is not running. Running mates: Ben Schierer (with Klobuchar), Ryan Wilson (with Demuth), and Jane Kirby (with Young).
